summary: The gaia implementation is essentially a skeletal mock. While agents are defined and can send basic messages, the core MarketplaceAgent lacks any implementation for processing these messages, executing matching algorithms, or managing auctions.

findings.description: The system fails to implement matching based on criteria (price, location, size, type).

findings.evidence: No auction-related behaviours or states in any of the agents.

findings.description: Acceptance/rejection of matches is only simulated via string messages without actual state changes.
findings.evidence: BusinessEntityAgent.RespondToMatchBehaviour sends 'ACCEPT' but it is not processed.

missing_requirements: System umożliwia parowanie lokali z biznesami poprzez aukcje, parowanie na podstawie (z zachowaniem koncepcji miasta 15-minutowego). Istotne czynniki parowania stanowią:• cena,• lokalizacja,• rozmiar,• typ działalności.
System umożliwia podanie górnej i dolnej granicy dla kryteriów parowania.
logical_inconsistencies: MarketplaceAgent declares a property_listings list, but its internal behaviours (e.g., ManagePropertyListingsBehaviour) do not use or update it.
BusinessEntityAgent sends matching boundaries, but MarketplaceAgent does not parse or use them.
implementation_risks: Message parsing relies on simple string splitting (msg.body.split(':')), which will crash if the message format is slightly incorrect.
